pk.context: 5 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: light red, round, biconvex, bevel-edged, film-coated tablet

clues.kinetics: Absolute bioavailability is about 30%, and food has no clinically relevant effect. Most of the dose is excreted unchanged, so metabolism is a minor route.
clues.substance: A free base, not a salt, with a molecular weight of 472.54. A solid that is not or only slightly hygroscopic and very slightly soluble in water.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA as 5 mg tablets, dosed once daily.
clues.safety: No boxed warning. Contraindicated with hypersensitivity to the drug or its excipients, including anaphylaxis and angioedema; nasopharyngitis and diarrhea are common.
clues.indication: Adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus; not recommended in type 1 diabetes mellitus.
clues.mechanism: Inhibits the enzyme DPP-4, which breaks down incretin hormones, so insulin release rises in a glucose-dependent way and glucagon secretion falls.

tell: A DPP-4 inhibitor with an unusually long terminal half-life of about 200 hours, from saturable binding to its target.

evidence.pk.tmaxH: peak plasma concentrations of linagliptin occurred at approximately 1.5 hours post dose
evidence.pk.halfLifeH: Linagliptin has a terminal half-life of about 200 hours at steady-state
